checks/dispatch_gate.failure: 0060: the orchestrator starts a coder before the train's plan is recorded or without a unit's Worktree line, starts a push agent or a foreign agent, or hands a coder a new unit that its binding never follows

dispatch_gate.R_FOREIGN_AGENT.failure: 0060: the orchestrator starts an agent outside the Daedalus catalog, whose calls no agent file binds

dispatch_gate.R_NEVER_STARTED.failure: 0001, 0060: the orchestrator starts the push agent or a second orchestrator, so a Build Train could push or fork its state

dispatch_binding.R_RESUME_LINE.failure: 0086: a resume names two units or a malformed Worktree line, so the coder's binding cannot follow it

dispatch_binding.R_RESUME_TARGET.failure: 0086: a resume handing over a unit names no coder, so no binding can move

dispatch_binding.R_RESUME_UNBOUND.failure: 0086: a resume moves a coder that holds no unit onto a unit another coder may already own

tool_bound.R_NO_DISPATCH_GATE.failure: 0060: the orchestrator's agent file loses its dispatch gate, so its Agent and SendMessage calls run unjudged

command_allowlist.R_ORCHESTRATOR_BASH.failure: 0001, 0060: the orchestrator runs a command outside its plugin scripts and read-only inspection, such as a push, a merge into main or its own stop
